about_the_game:
Auto Chess Souls is a casual strategy adventure game that combines auto-chess and roguelike elements. Through consecutive choices, your team grows increasingly stronger. Explore the unknown tower, collect powerful equipment, uncover mysterious relics, and create unique powerful combinations. Embark on this exciting adventure now!

Beginner's Tips

  • Two identical low-level tools can be combined into one high-level tool.

  • Two identical low-level chess pieces can be combined into one high-level chess piece.

  • Collecting a full set of items will activate set effects.

  • Relics provide global effects that apply to all your chess pieces.
